verdict.rationale: Intel publishes a concrete NPU TOPS figure (48 TOPS for Core Ultra Series 2/Lunar Lake) and an official developer SDK/runtime (oneAPI oneDNN + PyTorch optimizations, VTune profiler support for NPUs) that ships today, satisfying the core of the story. Missing for 10: explicit precision qualifier for the TOPS figure (e.g., INT8) and independent hands-on developer corroboration of NPU SDK usage.
